attributes: Per the texts: Thoth invented hieroglyphic writing and gave it to mankind, keeps the gods' records, reckons the years, and at the weighing of the heart stands by the balance recording the verdict for Osiris's court. attributes: Per the historical and cult record: a lion's body and a king's head (nemes headdress, royal beard in the fragments), carved from the plateau's own bedrock, facing east to the sunrise. In the New Kingdom it was worshipped as Harmakhis (Horus in the Horizon), a solar god in stone: the Dream Stela between its paws records how the young prince Thutmose (later Thutmose IV) slept in its shadow, dreamed the Sphinx spoke and promised him the kingship if he cleared its sand — and did. Note what it does not have: no riddle, no wings, no female form, no victims. The Greek figure (see bridge) borrowed the image and invented a different being around it.
